title: Astraea lexicon
description: Vocabulary declared in a file, one per language. The engine validates and applies it; the research maintains the terms. Derived from the Alétheia lexicon schema (MIT).

version.description: Date or version; goes to every output item and to the catalogue.

key.description: Unique in the lexicon; it is what the output cites.

forms.description: Spellings that count as the term. Case and accents ignored; whole word. An ellipsis (…) stands for up to 60 arbitrary characters, without crossing a semicolon or a line break.

exclusions.description: Expressions that, when they contain the occurrence, cancel it.

categories.description: Cataloguing facets (court, qualification, situation...). They go to the output and to the catalogue along with the key.

requires_any.description: Without at least one of these in the text, the item does not go beyond level 1.
